title: Chapter 464
paragraphs: Chapter 464
Episode 131. People with good intuition, people with bad intuition (8)
Dark spirit energy-infused sword attacks were fired at Amella, cutting through the dense barrage.
Each attack targeted her vital points without fail. Between the torn barrage, Jin's eyes were filled with a strong, thick killing intent.
In other words, he was serious. Jin had decided to kill Amella.
Feeling the vivid killing intent, as if it were a dark and poisonous mass, Amella shuddered, and her spine grew cold.
Clang-!
As their eyes met, Jin and Amella clashed weapons and struggled against each other. Bradamante and the cannon barrel formed by her energy collided, creating an unpleasant friction sound.
'At least he doesn't seem to lose his sanity upon seeing spirit energy like Yona. Is it because the type or size of the chaos is different? Or is there something else?'
She couldn't be sure of the reason, but it wasn't important to the fight at hand. In fact, it would have been easier if he had lost his sanity. He wouldn't have been able to unleash his full power.
As she tried to disengage her blade from the cannon barrel and swing again, Jin felt something solid gripping Bradamante tightly.
It was thorns. Thorns that unexpectedly covered the cannon barrel like a hedgehog were tangled up and holding Bradamante.

Taking advantage of the brief opening created by Jin trying to force the sword free, Amella didn't miss the opportunity to detonate a bomb on Jin's head. A bomb she made in an instant using her energy.
The loud noise made it feel as if her eardrums would burst. However, thanks to Muta's runes and armor, there was no actual damage.
Meanwhile, Murakan tried to take care of Rata and Fei, but as he ran, he suddenly felt a strange and dangerous sensation beneath his feet and quickly moved away.
Had he reacted even a moment later, he would have suffered a significant injury. Explosions were occurring where Murakan had stepped.
"Ha, strange. Why are bombs exploding from the ground?"
Murakan clicked his tongue as he looked at the round hole in the ground. The attack was consistent with what he had heard from Balkas.
There were methods unique to Amella. Bombs exploding underfoot, arrows shot with a time delay, various traps and strange devices.
Ordinarily, it would take time and preparation to set these up, but her infinite energy made it possible.
At her command, weapons and traps were continuously formed in all directions. Cannons and bombs, massive guillotines, spike nets, repeating crossbows, and more.

If it had been anyone other than Jin and Murakan, like a warrior or magician below the 10-star level, they would have been completely overwhelmed. The same would have been true even for a famous group of knights or mages.
However, the compatibility was just too bad.

The curse didn't work at all, leaving no gaps to exploit. The weapons and artillery she wielded were suitable for mass destruction but not for breaking through the defenses of top-tier warriors and magicians.
Of course.

With the infinite power of her energy, compatibility didn't really matter. As long as the fight continued until one side died, it would always be Amella's victory. Her opponents would eventually tire out.
Swoosh!

Bradamante drew sharp diagonal lines in the air. Despite the pouring barrage and activated traps, Jin persevered, evading and using his armor of spirit qi to narrow the distance between himself and Amella.
'The way she reacts to my attacks is far from the level of the top knights I know.'
When fighting completely exposed without any preparation, Amella wouldn't have been able to defeat Jin without infinite power.
'If not for her infinite power and rapid regeneration, she wouldn't be a difficult opponent.'
Jin believed in Teth's flames.

When he overcame Myron's Gates of Hell or Zephyrin's Void Space, Cheonghwa had already proven itself. If the nucleus-like space of the dense qi provided Amella with infinite power, then he should be able to deal with it in a similar way.
If he couldn't resolve it with pressure, even if he had to completely destroy the island, or even erase the entire army from the map, Jin was determined to make a decision against Amella.
However, there was one strange thing.
'But why is she fighting so stupidly?'
Jin described her as fighting stupidly for one reason.
Amella continued to 'dodge or block' Jin's attacks, as if she didn't have rapid regenerative abilities.
To give flesh and take bones. With Amella's level of rapid regeneration shown just before, she could apply this principle at any moment.
She could have deliberately allowed attacks to create openings or make her opponent careless, or even attempt self-destruction at any moment.
If Jin had rapid regeneration, he would have fought in such a way, not desperately dodging the dark sword like Amella.
Was it because she hated pain itself, regardless of regeneration? That didn't explain why she cut off her own left wrist to prove her rapid regeneration.
'No way.'
In the rune of Muta, Jin's pupils narrowed.

When he glanced at Murakan, he saw that the dense qi continued to form bombs and barriers. Murakan refrained from breaking through it recklessly, afraid that the Proch siblings would be injured, but the dark spirit qi became more prominent between the dense qi.
And every time the spirit qi was exposed, Jin felt Amella's breathing change slightly, as if barely suppressing fear.
It couldn't be hidden.
Against someone like Jin, fear could not be hidden or concealed; it could only be a weakness.
"It seems that wounds inflicted by spirit qi can't be healed, can they, Knight Amella?"
Amella's eyes widened from within her hood.
'How did he find out!?'
She almost blurted out an answer, but the next moment she swallowed her gasp. Bradamante's fierce attack brushed past her shoulder.
The fabric of her camouflage suit around her shoulder fell apart, as leaves and branches shattered. In between, vivid red blood spattered.
Amella couldn't properly react to the thrust. Although the ghillie suit was quickly repaired by the miasma, Jin didn't miss the moment right before the leaves and branches formed.
'The shoulder didn't regenerate.'
It was clear that the ghillie suit regenerating before the shoulder was an unnatural order.
So Jin was confident. The spirit energy could neutralize the chaos, at least some of the chaos abilities Amella had.
"It seems like I'm right since the talkative one has gone quiet."
Hwuru-!
A sharp flame wound around the spirit energy wrapped around the blade.
"I'll make sure not to cause too much pain."
The spirit energy and the blue flame were getting darker. Staring at the tip of the sword aimed at her without a hint of trembling, Amella felt this instinct.
'If it continues like this, I'll definitely die!'
She had experienced countless battlefields so far. Mercenary, avatar of the battlefield, nightmare of the Gaipa military road, etc. The titles following Amella represented the life she had lived.
There were intense wars that took her breath away, and there were battlefields that felt like a playground. She enjoyed the wars, but she had never felt such a strong threat of death before.
As with many titles, the names Amella gained did not express the other side at all.
For example, the reason she didn't care about the world even after experiencing so many wars, the reason she didn't even know the name Jin Runecandel, who heated up the world for years.
Chaos.
Amella had been listening to the voice of chaos spreading within her for her entire life.

Chaos prevented her from immersing herself in the life of the general public and made her unable to pay attention to others and the outside world. The Prochi siblings were an exception because they had the "smell of chaos".
No one taught her what loneliness was in the life and death of the battlefield, and it was very difficult to meet someone strong enough to teach and lead her in the battlefield.
Even if they met, there was no room for such bonds to form in a space where they tried to kill each other.
Chaos power obscured the many emotions she should have felt.
For example, Amella could be considered a child left alone in her own world. Thanks to the power of chaos, she naturally became a mercenary, but she was not much different from a beast.
'I'm scared... I don't want to die!'
Some might find it amusing that Amella wanted to live.
Amella had killed countless people on the battlefield and almost never spared those who bothered her.
But was it really the will of a poor newborn abandoned in a well right after birth, or the will of chaos?
One thing was certain: so far, no one had ever led Amella.
The spirit energy and the blue flame were no longer standing out in the barrage but were pushing it away and becoming enormous.
"Kid! I've got the snake eyes, now let's just destroy them with ease!"
While Amella was scared and lost her concentration, Murakan was able to recover the Prochi siblings.
There was no need to control their power anymore.
"With this sword, it will be a fitting end to the prestige you've built up throughout your life."
The blue flames and spirit energy spread all around and gathered to Jin in an instant.
Soon, Jin became the embodiment of the blue flame itself.
Sara Runecandel's demonic sword technique, Upwha. Jin looked down at Amella with blazing eyes like a judge.
The blue flame illuminated her face hidden by the ghillie hood.
Amella had a surprisingly young face for someone of the same age as Balkas.
For some reason, he felt uneasy.
It had been a long time since he had become accustomed to a world where death was inevitable.
'It would have been nice if we had a good relationship.'
In the moment of clearing his distracting thoughts and swinging his sword to unfold Upwha.
["Ha, I surrender!"]
Suddenly, Amella stretched out her hands haphazardly, shaking them and shouting.
["I surrender! I'm sorry, please stop…!"]
Amella even hesitated, shaking her head frantically.
'What...?'
Amella's sudden behavior made countless thoughts race through his mind.
'Is it a trap to avoid the situation, or is it sincere? If it's the latter, is it right to spare her? Hasn't Amella already agreed to join Kinzel?'
If he forcibly stopped the half-unfolded Upwha, he could fall into serious internal injuries.
However, Jin made a decision.
First, let's save her and listen to her story. However, he couldn't stop Upwha.
"Murakan!"
The blue-stained Bradamante fell towards Amella, and Jin clenched his teeth and called the name of the guardian dragon.
